changelog:
- Now uses a structured JSON request file for submissions instead of command-line arguments containing user data.
- Adds strong guidance to never put user queries, channel names, or file paths directly inside shell commands; always generate a JSON file and reference its path.
- Updates tool commands: submit requests by filename only and describes the new request JSON shape.
- Enforces stricter validation of task IDs before polling results, stopping with an error if the ID is invalid.
- Clarifies network boundary—skills only send data to chartgen.ai and do not support alternate API endpoints.
- Improves workflow documentation for secure and robust operation.
